maintain  /meɪnˈteɪn/
ELI5  To keep something working well.
中文  维护，保持
 
扩展
to keep something in good condition, or to continue it over time
Someone taking care of the things they own, so they last longer.
例句
I maintain my bicycle every month.
She maintains a small garden behind the house.
对话
A  Your bike still looks new.
B  I maintain it every month.
A  That explains it. Mine is falling apart.
fragile  /ˈfrædʒaɪl/
ELI5  Easily broken. Be careful with it.
中文  易碎的
